Explore the Barbados National Registry's published cardiovascular disease indicators.  
Each dashboard presents a focused group of measures, with its own interpretation, data table and public downloads.

## Choose a dashboard

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

::: {.callout-tip title="CVD burden" icon=false}

**Published**

Counts and the composition of hospital-registered cardiovascular disease events.

- Monthly, quarterly and annual counts
- Event, broad age-group and sex distributions
- Published data table and downloads

[Open dashboard →](burden/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

:::

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

::: {.callout-note title="CVD incidence" icon=false}

**In development**

Crude and age-adjusted rates describing the occurrence of new cardiovascular disease events.

- Crude incidence rates
- Age-adjusted incidence rates
- Annual trends

The dashboard link will be added once the indicator and publication workflow are complete.

:::

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

::: {.callout-note title="CVD mortality" icon=false}

**Planned**

A future dashboard for published cardiovascular disease mortality indicators.

- Final measures still to be agreed
- Data and publication pathway not yet implemented

Development will follow incidence.

:::
